title: Residential Framing Basics: Measure, Layout, Build
markdown:
# RCS Day 2 - Residential Framing Basics: Measure, Layout, Build
CTS Cohort 6 | CTS Day 10 | 2026-07-21 | 10:00 AM-3:00 PM

## Core rule
A professional does not guess. A professional checks, protects, and verifies.

## Big idea
Accurate framing begins before the saw starts: read the plan, measure twice, mark clearly, and verify the cut list.

## Architecture of the day
| Time | Instructor move |
|---|---|
| 10:00-10:15 | Arrival, PPE, retrieval warm-up |
| 10:15-10:30 | Morning quiz |
| 10:30-10:50 | Quiz review and measurement misconception check |
| 10:50-11:20 | Tape-measure and fraction model |
| 11:20-12:00 | Wall-member map and window-framing demonstration |
| 12:00-12:30 | Cut-list guided practice and lab release |
| 12:30-1:00 | Lunch and controlled reset |
| 1:00-2:25 | Individual capstone framing lab |
| 2:25-2:45 | Dimensions, diagonal QC, evidence, cleanup |
| 2:45-3:00 | Exit ticket and Day 3 preview |

## Learning targets
- Read a tape measure to 1/16 inch and add common fractions.
- Identify plates, studs, king studs, jack studs, header, sill, and cripples.
- Lay out a 4-foot by 3-foot training wall with a framed window opening.
- Complete an instructor-approved cut list and assemble a square wall frame.

## Materials and setup
- Six approved 4-foot by 3-foot capstone wall drawings and lumber kits
- Tape measures, pencils, squares, clamps, and member labels
- Instructor-controlled cutting tools with guards and task dust controls
- Approved fasteners and drivers
- Eye/hearing protection and station-control signage
- Evidence camera or approved device

## Instructor talking points
- Connect RCS01 systems thinking to structure: every later system depends on an accurate frame.
- Model tape-measure reading, fraction addition, a clear carpenter's mark, and a two-person verification callout.
- Teach the load-path idea at training level: roof/floor loads move through framing to the foundation.
- Explain the window-opening members and why dimensions must follow the approved training drawing.
- Demonstrate inspection of lumber, tool guards, work-zone control, clamping, and safe body position.
